project.name: Ravenroot Sandbox Supervisor Conformance Suite
project.description: SEC-11b. A conformance suite an integrator runs against their OWN SandboxSupervisorLauncher implementation to demonstrate it satisfies the contract SEC-11 declares (SandboxPolicy, SandboxSupervisorLauncher, SandboxSupervisorProtocol) -- never an adversarial escape suite run against a binary this project does not own. This module authors no copy of any of those contract types; it depends on the one authoritative definition on ravenroot-programming-graalvm. It is deliberately not a dependency of ravenroot-distribution and does not ship: the OS sandbox supervisor stays integrator-provided (option B), so this repository has nothing of its own to conformance-test in CI beyond the deliberately non-compliant fakes below, which exist only to prove the suite's own assertions are load-bearing.
